features.description: Public wouter routes render without login checks.
Preview renders the shared StudioTopbar, StudioMessage, StudioAgentWorkspace, StudioComposer, StudioPreflight and StudioStickerTask components.
Desktop View and Mobile View buttons switch the inspection container class in client state.
Visible cards and controls invoke local handlers but do not alter real jobs, images, versions or files.
Fixed message text and stage transitions replace LLM planning.
Fixed attachment chips are displayed; no file input or upload exists in Preview.
Generation, edit and retry labels only update local Demo state.
Quality, Provider, fallback, quota, checkpoint and preflight text is fixed Demo data.
Preview makes no API calls, does not generate, upload, persist, create PNG/ZIP, download files or restore versions.

not_implemented: Preview real PNG/ZIP creation or download
